[[File:Clue scroll (elite) detail.png|left|150px]]
A '''clue scroll (elite)''' is the second highest tier of [[Treasure Trail]]. It rewards an [[reward casket (elite)|elite reward casket]] upon completion.

Elite clue scrolls can be between 5 and 7 steps long.

After completing 200 elite clues, the player will be awarded a [[heavy casket]]. Elite clue scrolls are a random drop from a large variety of high-levelled monsters, [[impling]]s, [[raids]] rewards, and skilling clues such as [[clue nest]]s, [[clue bottle]]s, and [[clue geode]]s. 

Clue scrolls are the start of a [[treasure trail]] — a treasure hunt that sends players hunting all around [[Gielinor]] and other [[realms]]. At the end of the hunt, players receive a reward of items randomly selected from a specific list, with the possibility of receiving rare and valuable items. Elite clue scrolls are usually long and complex, and take significant effort to be completed — though not more so than their [[clue scroll (master)|master-tier]] counterparts. These clue scrolls have a greater list of requirements with respect to quests and item possession (for [[Ironman Mode|ironmen]]). For this reason, many players prefer to complete easy, medium, or hard clues, instead. Venturing into the [[Wilderness]] may be required in order to complete the steps, whilst coordinate clues will require the player to fight an [[Armadylean guard]] or a [[Bandosian guard]].

Completion of [[Elite Combat Achievements]] gives a 5% increased chance to receive an elite clue scroll from all sources, excluding implings. 

An elite clue scroll can be given to [[Watson]] along with an easy, medium, and hard clue scroll to receive a [[Clue scroll (master)|master clue scroll]].

==Mechanics==
===Dying with a scroll===
As clue scrolls are untradeable, they are sent to the [[gravestone]] if unprotected on [[PvP]] or [[PvM]] death, even above level 20 [[Wilderness]]. [[Clue box]]es are not necessary and only add additional risk when in the Wilderness.

===Multiple clues===
As with all tiers of clue scrolls, only one elite clue scroll can be held, kept in Death's Office or stored in a bank at one time; attempting to open a [[scroll box (elite)]] while holding an elite clue scroll gives the message {{mes|The clue box refuses to open - you already have a clue.}} However, it is possible to drop clues on the floor, where they'll stay for one hour, allowing players to have multiple clues at once. Dropping prior clue scrolls while having done some of their steps does NOT retain the steps of the dropped clue when starting a new one.

===Casting an alchemy spell===
When casting an alchemy spell on a clue scroll, if the game setting that triggers a warning on untradeable items is disabled, a different confirmation warning is triggered, asking "wouldn't you rather solve the clue?". If the game setting is enabled, only the regular question is triggered.

==Trivia==
* After the update of [[Update:Multiple Clues & Midsummer|18 June 2015]] it is now possible to have one clue scroll of each tier at a time, while previously the player could not get any clue scroll at all until completing or dropping the current one.
* Upon release, elite treasure trails were 9-12 steps long. Due to complaints about the substantial jump in the number of steps required, it was changed to 5-7 steps in [[Update:Lizardman Shaman Improvements|an update]] on [[13 July]] [[2017]].
* The cryptic clue "''Green is the colour of my death as the winter-guise, I swoop towards the ground.''" is part of the lyrics to the song ''December Flower'' by {{WP|In Flames}}.
